{{Current events|year=2018|month=03|day=1|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Law and crime
*Police in [[Oslo]], [[Norway]], say that the [[FBI]] is assisting in the investigation into two forged nominations of [[Donald Trump]] for the [[Nobel Peace Prize]]. The [[impersonator]] allegedly used the same [[Identity theft|stolen identity]] twice. [http://www.newser.com/story/256006/police-probing-fake-nobel-peace-prize-nomination-of-trump.html (''Newser'')] [https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/morning-mix/wp/2018/03/01/someone-forged-a-nobel-peace-prize-nomination-for-trump-norwegian-officials-say/ (''The Washington Post'')]
*[[Terrorism in Turkey]]
**[[Dilek Öcalan]], [[Grand National Assembly of Turkey|MP]] for the pro-[[Kurdistan|Kurdish]] [[Peoples' Democratic Party (Turkey)|HDP]] party, is sentenced to two and a half years in jail on charges of terror propaganda related to her participation in the 2016 funeral of a [[Kurdistan Workers' Party|PKK]] fighter. Nine HDP MP's are currently in jail. [http://www.nrttv.com/en/Details.aspx?Jimare=19018 (NRT)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Politics of Argentina]]
**[[2018 opening of regular sessions of the National Congress of Argentina]]
***[[President of Argentina|Argentine president]] [[Mauricio Macri]] delivers a speech in the Congress to start the regular sessions for 2018. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-argentina-politics-macri/argentinas-macri-calls-for-labor-amnesty-defends-gradual-approach-idUSKCN1GD5RF?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[Politics of Iraq]]
**The [[Council of Representatives of Iraq|Parliament of Iraq]] votes to oblige the [[Federal government of Iraq|federal government]] to set a schedule for the withdrawal of [[Military intervention against ISIS|foreign troops]]. [https://www.iraqinews.com/features/iraq-parliament-tells-govt-set-timetable-foreign-troops-pull/ (''Iraq News'')]
*[[Politics of the United States]]
**[[Russian interference in the 2016 United States elections]]
***A [[United States Senate Select Committee on Intelligence|Senate Intelligence Committee]] report says that  a [[United States House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence|House Intelligence Committee]] Republican was behind the leak to [[Fox News]] of private text messages between  a [[Russia]]n-connected  lawyer and Senator [[Mark Warner]], the committee vice-chairman. Committee chairman [[Richard Burr]] denies this information, first published by the ''[[The New York Times]]''. [https://www.nytimes.com/2018/03/01/us/politics/senate-intelligence-nunes-leaks.html (''The New York Times'')] [https://slate.com/news-and-politics/2018/03/momentum-builds-to-can-devin-nunes-from-house-intel-role.html (''Slate'')] [http://thehill.com/homenews/senate/376265-senate-intelligence-committee-concludes-house-republicans-leaked-warner-texts (''The Hill'')]
